en-us:
Video, Audio, and Ink tracks now share one timeline across Video Editor, Audio Editor, Ink Editor, and Export.

- New projects include a default track for video, audio, and ink.
- Audio clips and ink cels align on a shared time ruler and zoom scale.
- Ink cel widths reflect their exposure duration.
- Switching workspaces retains the shared playback position.
- Export ink animations as transparent, looping GIFs at 24–50 fps.
- Draw with vertical mirror symmetry or optionally snap strokes to the canvas grid.
- Object tracking retries with a wider search when fast movement defeats its local search.
- An optional beginner guide highlights controls and waits for your actions as you add media, draw, preview and export. Replay it from Help.
- Ripple trim, roll, slide and join now work on speed-ramped video clips without changing their timing.
- Animate cut-out layers or distance-weighted vector artwork with editable bones and timed poses.
- Draft lip-sync locally from audio, then edit mouth drawings and frame-aligned cues. Acoustic drafts need review; no model download is required.
- Alpha lock recolours existing artwork without extending its alpha, including soft edges, blur, smudge and connected-artwork fills.
- Import OBJ meshes with embedded diffuse MTL colours and PNG/JPEG/BMP textures into 3D scene nodes. Preview and export share perspective-correct textures.
